extracted.intended_audience: PCT applicants, patent attorneys/agents, and EPO/ISA/IPEA examiners and staff
extracted.subtask_description: Official EPO guidelines on fees, fee reductions/refunds, payment deadlines, and standards/procedures for international search and written opinion (EPO acting as ISA/SISA/IPEA). Covers timing, scope and quality requirements for searches, claim interpretation guidance, and administrative fee rules.

rubrics_metrics.name: Payment of missing amount with late payment fee (RO/EP)
rubrics_metrics.description: If the applicant pays the missing amount together with the late payment fee within the one-month time limit set in the invitation (Form PCT/RO/133), the payment is considered to have been received in time.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Failure to pay within the one-month limit will result in the international application being considered withdrawn and the RO/EP will so declare (Form PCT/RO/117). If payment is made after the time limit but before the RO/EP has despatched the notification of withdrawal, the payment is considered to have been received in time and the application will not be considered withdrawn.

rubrics_metrics.name: Fee for requesting restoration of priority right
rubrics_metrics.description: The fee for requesting restoration of priority right is payable for the benefit of the RO/EP and its amount is fixed by the EPO; it must be paid within the same time limit as for filing the request for restoration (two months from expiry of the priority period).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The amount payable is the amount applicable on the date of receipt of the request for restoration. The time limit for paying this fee is not extended if the EPO acts as receiving Office.

rubrics_metrics.name: Additional search fee (ISA/EP)
rubrics_metrics.description: Additional search fee paid in response to an invitation after a finding of lack of unity (Form PCT/ISA/206) is collected by the ISA/EP and its amount is fixed by the EPO.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This fee is to be paid within one month from the date of the invitation. The amount payable is the amount applicable on the date of receipt of the international application.

rubrics_metrics.name: Protest fee (ISA/EP)
rubrics_metrics.description: The protest fee is paid for the benefit of the ISA/EP and its amount is fixed by the EPO.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: It is to be paid within one month from the date of the invitation to pay additional fees after a finding of lack of unity (Form PCT/ISA/206). The amount payable is the amount applicable on the date of payment.

rubrics_metrics.name: Late furnishing fee for sequence listings (ISA/EP)
rubrics_metrics.description: The late furnishing fee for nucleotide and/or amino acid sequence listings is paid for the benefit of the ISA/EP and its amount is fixed by the EPO.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: It is payable within one month from the date of the invitation to furnish the sequence listing (Form PCT/ISA/225). The amount payable is the amount applicable on the date of payment.

rubrics_metrics.name: Supplementary search handling fee (IB for SIS)
rubrics_metrics.description: The supplementary search handling fee is collected by the IB for its own benefit and its amount is fixed by the IB; it is payable in Swiss francs.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: It is to be paid within one month from the date of receipt of the supplementary search request (Form PCT/IB/375). The amount payable is the amount applicable on the date of payment.

rubrics_metrics.name: Supplementary search fee (SISA/EP) payable to IB
rubrics_metrics.description: The supplementary search fee is collected by the IB for the benefit of the SISA/EP and its amount is fixed by the EPO.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: It is to be paid within one month from the date of receipt of the supplementary search request (Form PCT/IB/375). The amount payable is the amount applicable on the date of payment.

rubrics_metrics.name: Review fee (SISA/EP)
rubrics_metrics.description: The review fee is paid for the benefit of the SISA/EP and its amount is fixed by the EPO.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: It is to be paid within one month from the date of the notification of lack of unity.

rubrics_metrics.name: Handling fee for IPEA/EP (demand)
rubrics_metrics.description: The handling fee collected by the IPEA/EP is for the benefit of the IB and its amount is fixed by the IB.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: It is to be paid within one month from the date on which the demand (Form PCT/IPEA/401) was submitted or within which 22 months from the priority date, whichever time limit expires later. The amount payable is the amount applicable on the date of payment.

rubrics_metrics.name: Preliminary examination fee (IPEA/EP)
rubrics_metrics.description: The international preliminary examination fee collected by the IPEA/EP is for its own benefit and its amount is fixed by the EPO.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: It is to be paid within one month from the date on which the demand (Form PCT/IPEA/401) was submitted or within 22 months from the priority date, whichever time limit expires later. The amount payable is the amount applicable on the date of payment.

rubrics_metrics.name: Additional preliminary examination fee (IPEA/EP)
rubrics_metrics.description: Additional preliminary examination fee paid in response to an invitation after a finding of lack of unity (Form PCT/IPEA/405) is collected by the IPEA/EP and its amount is fixed by the EPO.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: It is to be paid within one month from the date of the invitation. The amount payable is the amount applicable on the date of payment.

rubrics_metrics.name: Protest fee (IPEA/EP)
rubrics_metrics.description: The protest fee payable to the IPEA/EP is fixed by the EPO.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: It is payable within one month from the date of the invitation to pay additional examination fees after a finding of lack of unity (Form PCT/IPEA/405). The amount payable is the amount applicable on the date of payment.

rubrics_metrics.name: Late furnishing fee for sequence listings (IPEA/EP)
rubrics_metrics.description: The late furnishing fee for nucleotide and/or amino acid sequence listings payable to the IPEA/EP is fixed by the EPO.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: It is payable within one month from the date of the invitation to furnish the sequence listing (Form PCT/IPEA/441). The amount payable is the amount applicable on the date of payment.

rubrics_metrics.name: Late payment fee rules (IPEA/EP)
rubrics_metrics.description: If fees paid to the IPEA/EP are insufficient or no fees were paid, the IPEA/EP invites the applicant to pay the missing amount together with a late payment fee within one month from the date of the invitation (Form PCT/IPEA/440).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The late payment fee is 50% of the amount of the unpaid fees as specified in the invitation or, if less than the handling fee, an amount equal to the handling fee; but it may not exceed double the handling fee. Complying within the time limit deems payment to have been made in time. Payment after the time limit but before despatch of the invitation is also considered in time. Failure to pay will result in the demand being considered as if not submitted.

rubrics_metrics.name: Fee reduction for electronic filing (international filing fee)
rubrics_metrics.description: International filing fee reductions apply for applications filed in electronic form; three levels depending on format: Web-form filing (WFF), PDF reduction, and XML reduction.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: WFF reduction: both request form and specification filed in PDF. PDF reduction: request in character-coded XML while specification in PDF. XML reduction: both request and specification in character-coded XML. Amounts set by the IB and applicable on date of receipt of the international application.

rubrics_metrics.name: 90% reduction for applicants from certain states (international filing fee)
rubrics_metrics.description: International filing fee is reduced by 90% if requirements in point 5 of the PCT Schedule of Fees are met (specific eligibility criteria).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: For filings at RO/EP, applies only if the applicant is a natural person who is a national of and resides in an EPC contracting state complying with point 5(a) criteria. If more than one applicant, only one needs to be national/resident, but each must meet other criteria in point 5. The 90% reduction is calculated after deduction of any electronic filing reduction.

rubrics_metrics.name: Reduction of international search fee for low-income applicants
rubrics_metrics.description: International search fee is reduced by 75% where the applicant (or each applicant if multiple) is a natural person who is a national and resident of a state classified by the World Bank as low-income or lower-middle-income on the filing date.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: List of eligible states is available on the EPO website; the reduction amount and applicability details are governed by the PCT Schedule and EPO decisions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Reduction of additional search fee when search fee reduction applies
rubrics_metrics.description: If the applicant fulfils the requirements for reduction of the international search fee, any additional search fee is validly paid upon payment of the reduced amount.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Applies to additional search fees charged after unity objections.

rubrics_metrics.name: Reduction of supplementary search handling fee
rubrics_metrics.description: The supplementary search handling fee is reduced by 90% under the same conditions as for the international filing fee.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This principle also applies to the supplementary search handling fee due under Rule 45bis.2.

rubrics_metrics.name: Reduction of preliminary examination fee
rubrics_metrics.description: Fee for international preliminary examination is reduced by 75% under the same conditions as the reduction of the international search fee.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If the applicant qualifies, additional preliminary examination fees are also validly paid upon payment of the reduced amount.

rubrics_metrics.name: General refund principle
rubrics_metrics.description: Fees paid by mistake or without cause (e.g., because the EPO is not the competent RO or IPEA) and amounts paid in excess of the amount due will be refunded.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Rights for refund extinguish after four years from the end of the calendar year in which the right originally arose, unless a written reasoned claim is filed.

rubrics_metrics.name: Refund of international filing fee
rubrics_metrics.description: The international filing fee is refunded where no date of filing can be accorded or the application is withdrawn or considered withdrawn before its transmittal to the IB.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Specific rules and applicable forms govern processing of such refunds.

rubrics_metrics.name: Refund of (additional) international search fee
rubrics_metrics.description: The international search fee is refunded where no date of filing can be accorded; or the international application is withdrawn or considered withdrawn before its transmittal to the ISA; or where it is withdrawn before the start of the international search; or where the EPO can base the ISR partly or entirely on an earlier search it has performed.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The EPO acting as ISA decides whether requirements are met and refunds the applicable amount. No refund for any search other than an EPO search on an earlier application from which priority is validly claimed.

rubrics_metrics.name: Full refund conditions (search fees)
rubrics_metrics.description: Full refund applies where the EPO can make full use of an earlier search report for drawing up the international search report.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Occurs notably where the claims of the earlier and later applications are identical, or where claims of the later application are limited with respect to those of the earlier application due to deletion of alternative features or introduction of limiting features that were contained in dependent claims of the earlier application.

rubrics_metrics.name: Partial refund conditions (search fees)
rubrics_metrics.description: Partial refund applies where the EPO can make partial use of the earlier search report for drawing up the international search report.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Typical cases: where claims of the later application are broader than those of the earlier application (generalisation) or where later claims are limited by a feature not disclosed in the earlier application but relating to the same invention as that searched in the earlier application.

rubrics_metrics.name: No refund conditions (search fees)
rubrics_metrics.description: No refund is due where the subject-matter claimed in the later application represents an invention different from that searched in the earlier application, or where legal requirements for a refund are not fulfilled (e.g., priority not validly claimed).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: References: Rule 40.2(c) and (e).

rubrics_metrics.name: Refund of additional search fees and protest fee after review
rubrics_metrics.description: If the Review Panel finds that a protest was entirely justified, the additional search fees and the protest fee will be refunded.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If the protest is only partly justified, the corresponding additional search fees will be refunded but not the protest fee (see GL/PCT-EPO B-VII, 7.2).

rubrics_metrics.name: Refund of supplementary search fee (SISA)
rubrics_metrics.description: The EPO as SISA will refund the supplementary search fee where before it has started the supplementary search the supplementary search request is considered not to have been submitted; or before it has started the supplementary search the international application or the supplementary search request is withdrawn.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Reference: Rule 45bis.6(d)(iii).

rubrics_metrics.name: Refund of review fee
rubrics_metrics.description: If the Review Panel finds that the lack of unity objection was not justified, the review fee is refunded to the applicant.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Reference: Rule 57.4 and related provisions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Refund of handling fee (IPEA) when demand withdrawn
rubrics_metrics.description: Where the demand for international preliminary examination is withdrawn before it has been sent by the IPEA/EP to the IB, or where the demand is considered not to have been submitted, 100% of the handling fee is refunded.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Specific procedural rules apply to determine refund entitlement.

rubrics_metrics.name: Refund of preliminary examination fee
rubrics_metrics.description: Where the international application or the demand for international preliminary examination is withdrawn before examination has commenced and within 30 months from the priority date, or where the demand is considered not to have been submitted, 100% of the fee for international preliminary examination is refunded.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: References: Rule 68.3(c) and (e).

rubrics_metrics.name: Refund of additional examination fees and protest fee (IPEA)
rubrics_metrics.description: If the Review Panel finds that a protest was entirely justified, the additional examination fees and the protest fee will be refunded. If partly justified, corresponding additional examination fees will be refunded but not the protest fee.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: See GL/PCT-EPO C-V, 5.2 for procedural details.

rubrics_metrics.name: Objective of the international search
rubrics_metrics.description: The objective is to discover the prior art relevant for determining whether the claimed invention is novel and involves an inventive step; results are communicated in an international search report.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The ISA may be exempted from searching some or all claimed subject-matter in cases (e.g., multiple inventions, excluded subject-matter). The ISA also formulates a preliminary, non-binding opinion on novelty, inventive step, and industrial applicability and, where appropriate, on added subject-matter, unity, insufficient disclosure, clarity/support issues, and formal defects.

rubrics_metrics.name: Equivalence of international and European searches
rubrics_metrics.description: No difference between an international and a European search in respect of method, thoroughness, or sources of prior art searched; criteria for search/examination (novelty, inventive step, industrial applicability, unity, non-patentable subject-matter, insufficient disclosure, clarity) are in principle the same.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: All applications treated the same irrespective of origin when EPO acts as ISA/IPEA.

rubrics_metrics.name: Time limit for establishing ISR and WO-ISA
rubrics_metrics.description: Time limit for establishing the international search report and the written opinion (WO-ISA) is three months from receipt of the search copy by the ISA or nine months from the priority date, whichever occurs later.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: In practice the search and written opinion should be established no later than 16 months from the priority date.

rubrics_metrics.name: Scope and completeness of the search
rubrics_metrics.description: The ISA must endeavour to discover as much of the relevant prior art as its facilities permit and must consult the documentation specified in the PCT Regulations (Rule 34); international search scope is equivalent to that of a European search.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Interpretation of 'as its facilities permit' and references to ISPE Guidelines for further detail.

rubrics_metrics.name: Effectiveness and efficiency of the search
rubrics_metrics.description: Searches should be performed effectively and efficiently in line with EPO Guidelines (Section B-III, 2.2).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: See GL/ISPE references for principles on achieving an effective and efficient search.

rubrics_metrics.name: Search in analogous fields
rubrics_metrics.description: Where appropriate, searches must include analogous technical fields.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Guidance and limits provided in Section B-III, 2.3 and Rule 33.2(b),(c); consult GL/ISPE 15.48-15.51.

rubrics_metrics.name: Search on the internet and dating internet citations
rubrics_metrics.description: Internet sources may be searched where relevant; special considerations apply for dating internet citations.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Section B-III, 2.4 applies mutatis mutandis; see GL/PCT-EPO G-IV, 6.4 for dating internet citations.

rubrics_metrics.name: Basis for the search — interpretation of claims
rubrics_metrics.description: The examiner should interpret claims consistently with EPO/ISPE guidance when determining the subject-matter to search.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Section B-III, 3.2 applies mutatis mutandis; see ISPE Guidelines for details on claim construction in searches.

rubrics_metrics.name: Claims with explicit references to description or drawings
rubrics_metrics.description: If claims contain explicit references to the description or drawings (permitted only where 'absolutely necessary'), the examiner should strive to search the technical features indicated, provided they are unambiguously defined by specific parts of the description.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If the reference does not clearly identify which subject-matter is included in the claim, the examiner may informally contact the applicant for clarification before the search. In the special case of omnibus claims ('substantially as herein described'), no request for informal clarification should be issued and the search report will be designated complete. Where the reference does not appear justified, raise an objection in the written opinion.

rubrics_metrics.name: Treatment of amended claims or incorporated missing parts/elements
rubrics_metrics.description: Amended claims or claims incorporating missing parts/elements affect the basis and scope of the search and should be handled according to the relevant Guidelines (section begins in text).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Examiners should follow the guidance in subsequent sections (not fully included in this chunk) regarding searching amended claims and incorporated matter; informal clarification procedures may apply.
